newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends at 35.67 vs dlr in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends at 35.67 vs dlr in active trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.66/68 against the dollar on Friday after opening the day steady at 35.65/66, dealers said.
"We saw some good demand (for dollars) today after a long lull," said a dealer at a foreign bank. He said a leading dollar buying bank was joined by several local banks on Friday.
The Reserve Bank of India was also in the market buying dollars, dealers said. The dollar saw a high of 35.6750 and this may be a pointer to the days to come, dealers said.
"With premia coming down, demand should emerge in the spot market over the next two weeks," said a dealer.
Premia in the forward dollar market has been soft in recent weeks on expectations of a cut in cash reserve ratio for banks.
